description.zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or STS temporary authorization for authentication.

description.zh:
排序字段，可选值：

- label_name：默认，按类标名称排序
description.en:
The field to sort the results by. Valid values:

- `label_name`: Sorts by label name (default).

description.zh:
企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https:
//devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The organization ID. You can obtain the organization ID from the URL of your organization on Alibaba Cloud DevOps. The URL is in the format `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

description.zh: 页码，默认值为1，从第1页开始
description.en: The page number of the results to return. Starts from 1. Default: 1.

description.zh: 每页大小，默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
description.en: The number of results per page. The value must be between 1 and 100. Default: 20.
The ID or full path of the repository.

description.zh: 搜索关键字，匹配类标名称
description.en: A keyword used to filter labels by name.

description.zh:
排序方式，默认为desc
- desc：降序
- asc：升序
description.en:
The sort order. Default: `desc`. Valid values:

- `desc`: Descending

- `asc`: Ascending

description.zh: 是否返回关联的合并请求数量，默认为false，不返回
description.en: Specifies whether to return the count of associated merge requests. Default: `false`.
